page_topic_one_liner: AI training data platforms — labeling, RLHF preference pairs, licensed marketplaces, and multimodal dataset pipelines for model weights
differentiator_vs_generic: This is training-data procurement infrastructure (Scale, Labelbox, Wirestock lanes), NOT inference hosting, NOT web scraping APIs, NOT post-training evaluation dashboards. Hero must show annotation/RLHF dataset production — bounding boxes, A-vs-B preference rows, and versioned dataset stacks.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Multimodal labeling workbench — split panel with image bounding-box annotations on left, side-by-side RLHF preference pair cards (A vs B with thumbs-up/down blur icons) on right, accent border on selected preference
Dataset versioning stack: 3 layered dataset snapshot cards with version hash blur labels and provenance chain icon
Secondary: small pipeline flow arrow from raw media icons (image/video/doc) into labeled export crate labeled blur only
anti_patterns: Generic cloud server rack as hero
LLM chat panel (this is data labeling not GEO)
Inference GPU cluster unrelated to dataset QA
